          properties:

              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-

                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence number (one more than the owners already
                in that city) assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household
                (same lastName and address, case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace).
                Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and
                an existing same-household owner is found; the joining owner and the
                existing owner(s) all receive this same value. Null when the owner does
                not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-

              type: string

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. When true, the create request is allowed even if
            another owner has the same lastName and address (case-insensitive, with
            collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a request is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence number (one more than the owners already
                in that city) assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household
                (same lastName and address, case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace).
                Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and
                an existing same-household owner is found; the joining owner and the
                existing owner(s) all receive this same value. Null when the owner does
                not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0) and an email address is present; otherwise 'BRONZE'.
                Derived from the owner's own namesakeCount and email.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9+ ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when not supplied it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only request flag. When true, the create request is allowed even if
            another owner has the same lastName and address (case-insensitive, with
            collapsed whitespace); otherwise such a request is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted for display as 'LastName, FirstName',
                derived from the stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the first
                and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence number (one more than the owners already
                in that city) assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived from the
                owner's own customerCode and registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that live in the same household
                (same lastName and address, case-insensitive with collapsed whitespace).
                Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true and
                an existing same-household owner is found; the joining owner and the
                existing owner(s) all receive this same value. Null when the owner does
                not belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1C9D8B7E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName compared
                case-insensitively. Assigned at registration and never updated.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0) and an email address is present; otherwise 'BRONZE'.
                Derived from the owner's own namesakeCount and email.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's canonical region, derived from the city via a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

## Summary

I implemented `locality` as a read-only field derived from an owner's city, surfaced on both `POST /api/owners` and `GET /api/owners/{id}` responses (both serialize through `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto`).

**Changes:**
1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `locality` property to the `Owner` schema (so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it), documenting the fixed table and the `UNKNOWN` fallback.
2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/Locality.java`** (new) — a small helper with `static String of(String city)` implementing the fixed table (`Sydney→NSW`, `Melbourne→VIC`, `Brisbane→QLD`, else `UNKNOWN`).
3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added `@Mapping(target = "locality", expression = "java(Locality.of(owner.getCity()))")`, matching the existing derived-field pattern (`displayName`, `membershipTier`, …).

**Notable pitfall caught and fixed:** my first attempt put the lookup as a `default String locality(String)` method on the mapper interface. That compiled but broke `POST` with a 500 at persist time — MapStruct auto-selects any `String→String` method as an implicit converter for *every* String property, so `telephone`/`city`/etc. were routed through it, leaving `telephone` non-normalized and failing the entity's E.164 `@Pattern`. Moving the logic to a standalone helper class (no String→String method on the mapper) resolved it. I verified this by isolating the regression against the reverted baseline before committing to the helper-class approach.
